landing.headline: Learn Better, Your Way.
landing.subHeadline: MindFlow is an accessible language learning platform built for every kind of learner — with built-in support for Dyslexia, ADHD, and sensory differences.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Traditional learning platforms are cluttered and often inaccessible to learners with Dyslexia, ADHD, or sensory challenges. MindFlow strips away the noise and offers structured, inclusive language learning with accessibility baked in — not bolted on.
mission.problemText: Existing platforms overwhelm learners with disabilities. There is no clean, focused, multi-modal solution designed from the ground up for accessibility.
mission.solutionText: MindFlow provides structured learning paths, Dyslexia-friendly fonts, text-to-speech, gamification, and role-based portals — all in a distraction-free interface.

novelties.subTitle: Only real features — no hype.
novelties.f1Desc: One-click OpenDyslexic font toggle across the entire platform, reducing letter confusion for dyslexic learners.
novelties.f2Desc: Every page supports Read Aloud via the Web Speech API. Content is read naturally with pitch and rate controls in the sidebar.
novelties.f3Desc: XP points, level rings, daily streaks, and badge collections keep learners motivated and reward consistent effort.
novelties.f4Desc: Interactive phonics, letter tracing on canvas, memory match with emoji, word builder (drag & drop), and rhyme lab.
novelties.f5Desc: Students and teachers can post discussions, ask questions, and reply — stored locally so it works without a running backend.
novelties.f6Desc: Separate dashboards for Students, Teachers, Guardians, and Admins — each with context-appropriate tools and analytics.

previews.p1Desc: XP rings, course progress, and daily streak — all at a glance.
previews.p2Desc: Dyslexia font, TTS, high contrast, and focus mode — one click away.
previews.p3Desc: Real-time grammar and sentiment feedback on your writing.

future.e1: AI Voice Tutor — speech recognition for live pronunciation feedback
future.e2: Adaptive learning paths that adjust difficulty based on quiz performance
future.e3: Offline mode with mobile PWA support for low-connectivity learners
future.e4: Expanded multilingual support beyond English and Hindi
